verdict.rationale: Data-usage and training opt-out controls are a fair question for an AI API provider, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers data retention, training opt-out, or zero-data-retention policies. The fine-tuning docs describe training your own custom models, which is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
